property_summary: For any caller, c.owner() always returns the same owner address set at initialization, regardless of who queries it; the buggy version instead returns msg.sender once the owner is address(0), so a query from a different caller after renounceOwnership returns the caller's address instead of address(0).
change_summary: Change the return statement to return the roundImplementation-typed zero unless owner set, by returning the negated check result cast to address: return _owner != address(0) ? _owner : _msgSender();
